messages.content: Add a simple auth token check: in middleware.rs add `check_auth(token: &str) -> bool`, in routes.rs add a /protected route that calls it, and in models.rs add an AuthRequest struct with a token field. All three files must compile together.

content.text: I'll start by exploring the project structure to understand the codebase.

input.command: find . -type f -name "*.rs" | head -50; echo "---"; cat Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null
input.description: Find Rust files and read Cargo.toml

content.text: Found the project. Let me read all four files.
Let me establish a build baseline before changing anything, and check the toolchain.

content.text: Good catch needed: my `assert_eq!` in the routes test compares `Result<User, _>`, which requires `User: PartialEq` — a derive the task didn't authorize adding. Let me fix that test instead.
